name: Joshua Rotenberg
body: PDQ's own value of ownership, taking responsibility for outcomes and following through on commitments, is the standard I hold my own client work to at Solenzo, where I design and run the full customer lifecycle myself: onboarding nurture, win-back, and reactivation sequences built on defined segmentation and lifecycle-stage frameworks. That's close to exactly what this role is asking someone to own for PDQ's customer base.

At Wix, I directly managed a team of onboarding specialists for two years, a team of 20, later 8, while my own account portfolio drove a 30% increase in traffic and a 25% improvement in conversion for the accounts I managed. At Birdeye, I managed a reseller partner book of 15-20 accounts and retained all but one, a 94% retention rate, by advising partners on retention strategy and customer health metrics. Between the two, I've built and personally run the mechanics of what keeps a B2B SaaS customer base engaged and renewing, not just directed someone else to.
I'd welcome the chance to talk through how that experience maps to what PDQ needs from this role. I'm available at 303-726-5037 or jrotnbrg@gmail.com.
